name: Default Collage
description: Multi-image collage layout profile. Give it an image directory + a canvas preset, get candidate layouts to compare — PowerPoint-Designer style. Design SSOT: docs/COLLAGE-DESIGN.md.

layout.capacity: Up to ~15 images per Letter page; split pages beyond that.

exportModes.darkPdf: Full-color dark canvas via html_to_pdf.py --pdf-theme dark.
exportModes.png: Social-size exports (16:9, 9:16, 1:1, ...) render via pdf_to_png.py or direct screenshot at the pixel preset.
exportModes.bundle: A collage page is Letter HTML like any other — merge_pdfs.py can append it to a resume/portfolio bundle.

_note: default-collage.html is a hand-built reference render of the hero-mosaic family (6 images, Letter portrait) using CSS-gradient placeholder tiles — swap in real tags or run the planned generator. Real image sets live in storage/collages// (gitignored).
